info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Loan Application Collateral Management API
info.description: This API facilitates the management of collateral associated with loan applications. By enabling users to securely submit collateral details, it ensures that all necessary information is gathered effectively during the loan approval process. Financial institutions, lenders, and property assessors commonly use this API to enhance loan application reviews and validations. With this endpoint, stakeholders can streamline their workflows and improve the overall efficiency of the collateral evaluation process.

post.summary: Create a collateral for a loan application.
post.description: This endpoint allows the user to create a new collateral associated with a specific loan application. Ensure that the loan application exists before attempting to create a collateral.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to create new collateral entries associated with the loan application identified by RES-100045. Ensure to include all required properties in the payload to successfully register the collateral.
